description: The power of enlightenment; the society will discover or develop technologically, scientifically, socially, culturally, or religiously. Becoming the best at something (mining, farming, boat-making, armor-crafting, architecture, medicine) or becoming paragons of new thinking; governments (feudalism, republic, aristocracy, etc), philosophy (pacifism, militarism, socialism, etc), arts (music, painting, sculptures) or becoming moved by their beliefs to build monuments, spread religion, or adhere to dogmas.
fantasticalDescription: The power of fantastical enlightenment; magical discoveries, divine revelations, etc.
